name: Rachel Schaevitz

current_positions.title: 传播、媒体与倡导负责人
current_positions.description: Oversees all communications and media engagement at Oxfam Aotearoa, enhancing the organisation's reputation and supporting international development, humanitarian, and climate justice initiatives.

education.notes: Graduated from NYU with a degree in film studies in December 2001.
Obtained master's degree in film studies from Boston University.

education.institution: Temple University (Klein College of Media and Communication)
education.notes: Earned her doctorate in media and communication from Klein College, Temple University. Dissertation: 'Without words: The use of an image-based instructional video to convey information to culturally diverse audiences,' focusing on how silent film techniques could help non-native English speakers navigate the American health care system.

work_experience.title: Head of Communications, Media and Advocacy
work_experience.description: Leads all communications, media engagement and advocacy at Oxfam Aotearoa. Oversees the organisation's public messaging on climate justice, humanitarian aid, Pacific development, and global inequality. Manages media strategy for campaigns including climate finance for the Pacific region and humanitarian crisis response in Gaza and elsewhere.

work_experience.title: Communications Lead / Communications Manager
work_experience.description: Previously served in a more junior communications role at Oxfam Aotearoa before being promoted to Head of Communications, Media and Advocacy.

work_experience.title: Associate Director for State Outreach and Strategic Partnerships
work_experience.title_zh: 州外联与战略合作伙伴关系副主任
work_experience.organization: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校公共人文学科(Carolina Public Humanities, UNC Chapel Hill)
work_experience.description: First person to hold this position at Carolina Public Humanities. Built relationships with community colleges, nonprofits, museums and other institutions to extend UNC humanities programming across the state of North Carolina. Developed programs including Humanities Happy Hour and Morning at the Movies partnership with Chelsea Theater.

work_experience.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in the Public Humanities
work_experience.title_zh: 公共人文学科博士后研究员
work_experience.organization: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校(University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill)
work_experience.description: Two-year Postdoctoral Fellowship in the Public Humanities through Carolina Public Humanities. Helped broaden the organisation's reach beyond traditional weekend seminars and public lectures. Developed programs including Humanities Happy Hour and Language Lunches.

work_experience.title: Town Council Member
work_experience.description: Elected to the Chapel Hill Town Council in 2017, inspired by the 2017 Women's March in Raleigh, North Carolina. Served as liaison to the Chapel Hill Arts Commission and on the Orange County Visitor's Bureau Board of Directors.

work_experience.title: English Teacher
work_experience.description: Moved to China for one year to teach English after graduating from NYU.

biography_summary: 蕾切尔·谢维茨（Rachel Schaevitz）是一位美国裔传播与媒体专业人士，现任乐施会新西兰（Oxfam Aotearoa）传播、媒体与倡导主管。她拥有丰富的跨领域职业经历，涵盖电影行业、学术研究、公共人文学科推广以及非营利组织传播管理。谢维茨2001年从纽约大学电影研究专业毕业，随后前往中国担任一年英语教师。2007年她在波士顿大学获得电影研究硕士学位，2014年在天普大学克莱因媒体与传播学院获得媒体与传播博士学位。她的博士论文研究如何利用无声电影技巧帮助非英语母语者理解美国医疗体系，体现了她将媒体作为社会变革工具的核心理念。完成博士学业后，她在北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校（UNC Chapel Hill）的公共人文学科项目担任两年博士后研究员，期间开发了包括'人文快乐时光'和'语言午餐'在内的创新社区参与项目。随后她被任命为公共人文学科州外联与战略合作伙伴关系副主任，成为首位担任此职位的人，负责将北卡罗来纳大学的人文学术项目推广至全州各地的社区学院、博物馆和非营利组织。2017年，受妇女游行运动启发，她当选为北卡罗来纳州教堂山镇议会议员，展现了基层政治参与精神。谢维茨目前居住在新西兰奥克兰，自2020年8月起在乐施会新西兰担任传播、媒体与倡导主管，负责该组织的所有传播和媒体参与工作，重点关注气候正义、太平洋地区发展、人道主义危机响应和全球不平等议题。她的职业生涯始终贯穿一条主线——运用媒体和传播手段推动社会变革和公共福祉。
